title: Hotter and Colder: A New Approach to Annotating Sentiment, Emotions, and Bias in Icelandic Blog Comments
measurement_description: The paper measured hate speech which included denigration based on protected characteristics, one of which was religion.
findings: The study included religion as a category for hate speech detection, but it did not report any specific findings or results related to religion. The analysis was aggregated with other forms of hate speech.
